connectionConfigSchema.title: GOOGLE_ADWORDS_REMARKETING_LISTS rETL connection config
connectionConfigSchema.description: Per-connection destination config for a VDM v2 rETL connection, as accepted in `destinationConfig` on POST /v2/retl-connections. Keys match what the transformer reads off connection.config.destination in processVDMV2RecordEvents. syncMode, schemaVersion, eventType, identifierMappings and fieldMappings are written by config-backend and are not caller-settable; createAudience belongs to the integrations-info /setup flow, which this connection flow does not use.

audienceId.description: The Google Ads user list this connection delivers to. Required: the transformer rejects a record batch without it.

isHashRequired.description: Required: an omitted value is read as `false`, and `processAudienceRecord` then throws a hashing-consistency error on raw warehouse values. The destination's own configSchema defaults it to true, but nothing applies that default to the per-connection block.
